import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    b = int(next(it))
    arr = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    cuts = []
    even = 0
    odd = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if i != 0 and even == odd:
            cuts.append(abs(arr[i] - arr[i - 1]))
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            even += 1
        else:
            odd += 1
    cuts.sort()
    count = 0
    for cost in cuts:
        if cost <= b:
            count += 1
            b -= cost
        else:
            break
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
